notes:
High-level: Iron Ink builds a VS Code extension used by engineering teams at mid-size SaaS companies. Primary differentiator is ultra-low-latency streaming completions and contextual inline suggestions anchored to workspace symbols and private code indexes.

Key technical requirements: streaming tail latency <100ms median token (goal 50-80ms for tight inline IA), ability to pin model versions per-customer and rollback quickly, per-developer rate limiting and burst controls at the extension-proxy level, fine-grained audit logs for snippet access and generation, optional VPC connector for enterprise customers.

Security/compliance: enterprise pilot requires SSO (SAML) + audit export to SIEM and KMS-integrated key control for any persisted embeddings. Asked specifically for retention controls (30/90/365 day options) and a clean telemetry opt-out for snippet caching.

POC scope agreed in email: run 5 developer seats for 48 hours against two model configs (low-latency small quantized model and higher-quality float model) to capture median/90p token latency, top-k latency distribution, streaming reconnect behavior, and cost-per-1000-tokens. Measure impact of Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching/caching) on perceived responsiveness.

Commercial / pricing notes: product team quoted concern about billing model when extension proxies requests on behalf of end users (billing per-developer vs per-organization). Finance asks for predictable per-seat committed pricing; engineering asks for dynamic rate-limit hooks (quota per-seat) that degrades gracefully. Estimated ARR if pilot successful: $50k-$120k.

Quotes / call snippets:
- CTO Elliot Park: 'We can't have stalls while a dev types — latency is everything. Also need predictable unit costs.'
- Lead Platform Eng (Marta Silva): 'If we adopt, need model pinning for release trains; we can't have a drift in suggestions across environments.'

Open questions / asks for Redwood:
- Provide benchmark harness for extension proxy (we want an apples-to-apples latency test).
- Clarify rate-limiting API and webhook for overage events.
- Confirm export format and retention controls for audit logs.

Next steps (short): SE to schedule POC kickoff (Priya Nair). Security to share SOC2 snapshot and SSO flow. Procurement to sign 2-month trial agreement if POC metrics meet thresholds.
